text:
Maria Chen: Need a quick sanity check. I submitted a 12-GPU reserved request in us-west-2 (placement group z1) at 09:02 and it's stuck in PROVISIONING. UI shows 'waiting for placement capacity'.
Kevin Ortiz: saw that. Are we blocked on AZ-specific inventory?
Maria Chen: looks like z1 is depleted for the instance type we requested. The API allowed the request but scheduler can't bind.
Samir Patel: ahhh — we recently pinned that pool to specific placement groups to avoid cross-AZ latency. Might be too restrictive for large requests.
Kevin Ortiz: can you paste the reservation payload?
Maria Chen: ```json
{
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "az": "us-west-2a",
  "placement_group": "z1",
  "gpus": 12,
  "instance_type": "a100-80gb",
  "commit_term": "12_months"
}```
Lia Gomez: tagging finance — if this drags on we might hit on-demand spillover that will bill at higher rate. Do we have a fallback pricing rule? :eyes:
infra-bot: Reservation 1868000000 status changed -> PROVISIONING (09:04). Auto-retry scheduled in 10m.
Samir Patel: short-term fix: we can relax placement_group constraint to allow any AZ in region. That needs a config change in the allocation policy.
Kevin Ortiz: agree. But note that dedicated customers expect placement guarantees. This is a self-serve dev reservation though?
Maria Chen: it's a platform team experiment, so we can be flexible. Change proposal: relax to any AZ for requests >=8 GPUs unless customer opted-in.
Lia Gomez: finance approves temporary relax for this ticket. But please add a tag so we can reconcile billing differences.
Kevin Ortiz: I pushed a change to the scheduler: allow_az_relaxation = true for reservation id 1868000000. Will monitor.
infra-bot: Reservation 1868000000 status changed -> BINDING (09:11).
Maria Chen: confirmed binding progressing. ETA to active ~4 mins.
Samir Patel: follow-up: we should update the UX to warn when placement groups are low capacity and surface alternative recommendations (e.g., cross-AZ).
Lia Gomez: also open a billing investigation: I see an invoice line where 9 hours of on-demand were billed under a different project tag when we had the fallback enabled last week. Need breakdown. @Kevin Ortiz can you dump audit logs?
Kevin Ortiz: grabbing logs now and will post link.
Kevin Ortiz: https://internal.redwood/infra/logs/1867999000 - shows allocation switched from reserved to on-demand at 01:22 UTC due to capacity mismatch.
Lia Gomez: perfect, I'll reconcile with cloud billing and request credit if it's an infra-side fail.
Maria Chen: reservation 1868000000 is ACTIVE now. Thanks for fast turnaround. :tada:
Samir Patel: filing a short RFC: propose automatic AZ-flex for large dev reservations + UI hint + tagging for finance. Will drop draft in #eng-infra-docs.
Lia Gomez: thanks team. Please include the invoice lines and cost delta in the RFC so finance can pre-approve the policy.
Maria Chen: will do. Closing this thread for now.
